title: Welcoming Martin del Rosario to Increase
summary: Martin del Rosario has joined Increase after serving as Global Head of Payments at Uber. He brings more than a decade of experience in payments, with prior stints at Remitly and Stripe.
body_markdown:
I’m thrilled to welcome Martin del Rosario to the Increase team!


Martin joined us after serving as Global Head of Payments at Uber. He brings more than a decade of experience in payments, with prior stints at Remitly and Stripe.


As a payments operator, Martin experienced the gaps in bank integrations firsthand: incoming payments with names too jumbled to screen or an ACH integration that couldn’t tell him why a transfer came back.


Increase passes high fidelity details from the payment networks through to our users, so you don’t have to work around these kinds of gaps.


This is the perfect time for Martin to join us. We launched Increase Bank a few months ago. We’ve crossed $500B in annualized transaction volume. Our growth is accelerating.


I couldn’t be more excited to build with you, Martin!
